opening.text: I can't hear as well as I used to, and this has been happening for a year. It affects all sounds, which sound jumbled and distorted, especially in crowded places or when I watch television. I occasionally have ringing in both ears. I was in the army, and it was always loud. I take hydrochlorothiazide, and for the past 25 years, I have also taken aspirin daily to protect my heart.
